# on a harness test referencing fixtures that do not exist in this layout).
#
# See harness/core/quality_gate/cross_artifact.py:481 and the tool_runners
# pytest invocation paths for why this matters at the gate level.
#

# vendored harness/, all of `.methodology/`, etc. — and blow past the
